target.title: A cubic lower bound on border determinant size for the permanent, claimed in unrefereed 2026 reports
target.plain: Checked: over the complex numbers, an m by m permanent written as a determinant of affine forms, or as a limit of such determinants, needs size n with 3n at least 2m^2 - 10m + 11 [L-gct-070]. How this statement stands against published work is with a specialist and is not claimed here. The program's target is a cubic bound that unrefereed 2026 reports claim; this project has not verified it and has no proof route to it at present.

target.goal: Goal: a lower bound on the size of a determinant that computes the permanent. Dormant; its checked results are on the record.

hard_link.why_hard: Every counting argument tried on it failed where two such AND gates share a gate that other parts of the circuit read. Its first rung, exactly one such gate, is cut into twelve cases: two are checked, ten are conjectures waiting for proofs.
hard_link.plain: The hard step, a conjecture on the desk: a smallest such circuit, in a normal form, never contains an AND gate that is true at an input the circuit rejects.
